messages:
sam (People Ops): Heads-up: new "review accelerator" flow for this cycle to reduce panel time. Read the checklist below.

sam (People Ops): Deadlines: forms due THU 11:59pm PT. Accelerator runs FRI morning (asynchronous reviews) + FRI afternoon live sync (20m panels). Request exceptions by Tue noon.

nora (People Ops): What is the accelerator? It's a short pre-triage + sample QA step: managers tag obvious cases, we sample 10% for quick QA, then only borderline/flagged entries hit the live panel.

kevin (Eng Manager): How do we tag obvious cases? We had "quick-pass" before  want consistent rules.

nora (People Ops): Use tag "accelerator:quick" and include at least 2 evidence bullets and a suggested rating. Quick-pass must have zero disciplinary flags and up-to-date project context.

ada (IC): Can ICs see manager notes during accelerator phase? We prefer transparency.

sam (People Ops): Default: manager notes shared post-accelerator. Managers can opt-in to "share-draft" but please avoid definitive wording until calibration.

li (EM): For hires <10w, what's the expected evidence? We have several contractors.

nora (People Ops): Flag hires <10w as "early-data" and include onboarding checkpoints + one evidence bullet if present. They will be excluded from quick-pass sampling.

kevin (Eng Manager): CSV/import headers again? We keep tripping on this.

sam (People Ops): Exact headers: employee_email,manager_summary,accelerator_tag. Lowercase, comma-separated. Our validator tool will be posted in #review-ops in 1h.

forms-bot: Reminder scheduled: Review forms due in ~48 hours. Link: https://app.redwood/reviews

nora (People Ops): QA sample: we'll pull 10% of quick-pass rows at random for a 5-min QA check to ensure consistency. If a case fails QA, it goes back to the full calibration pool.

kevin (Eng Manager): Overflow policy?

sam (People Ops): Teams >20 reports get one floater reviewer. For heavy cross-timezone teams, add a note in the signup sheet so we can match morning/evening coverage.

ada (IC): Thanks  small process sounds helpful.

sam (People Ops): We'll post a 1-pager "accelerator checklist" and a short example manager_summary template in #review-ops shortly. Ping @nora or me with import errors. :white_check_mark:
